doc.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The jazz-corner club with three bands: Basie, Betty Carter, Blakey and Trane
summary: Walton describes the basement club's layout and capacity, hearing Basie and Joe Williams for the first time on a bill with Betty Carter, Blakey and Coltrane, and Brower asks about the economics.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene
